profile.headline: Senior Special Software Engineer at L3Harris Technologies
profile.summary:
PROFILE:
Results-driven Senior Specialist Software Engineer with more than 19 years of experience in designing, developing, testing, the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and implementing high-quality software solutions.  Well-rounded in full-stack development, agile and waterfall methodologies.  Also, very experienced in various programming languages, such as object oriented C#/NET programming, SQL, etc.  Highly experienced in source control systems and version control systems, such as Azure DevOp, SVN, GitHub, Conference and Bitbucket. Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, coupled with a track record of successful project delivery and team collaboration.  Continually seeking opportunities to drive innovation and contribute to the growth of the organization.

OBJECTIVE:
Highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Specialist Software Engineer with over 19 years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing software solutions. Seeking to leverage my technical and analytical skills to effectively fulfill the role of a Senior Software Engineer at an esteemed organization. Committed to drive strategic planning and project management skills with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that align with business objectives.

SUMMARY:
●	Obtain an active secret clearance
●	Knowledgeable Software Engineer with more than 19 years of experience in software development
●	Proven expertise in the design and development of software databases and optimization of user interfaces
●	Obtain a Lean Six Sigma green belt certification
●	Part of an emerging leadership program alumni team
●	Experience source control systems and version control systems, such as Azure DevOp, SVN, GitHub, Conference and Bitbucket type of environments
●	Experience with multiple programming languages, such as C#, .NET, SQL, JavaScript and Python 
●	Experience working in object-oriented programming, test automation development, application development, test development and CI/CD type of environments
●	Knowledge of databases, including Microsoft SQL Server Management, IBM Doors, Oracle, and Microsoft Access
●	Ability to design and implement APIs
●	Extensive experience with testing and debugging
●	Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking and communication, innovation skills
●	Ability to work independently or in a team environment
●	Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
●	Knowledge of software development best practices

positions.title: Senior Specialist Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Work in an Advance Development (DevOps) environment
●	Use GitHub when creating, storing and/or managing shared software development source code
●	Help Leading, designing and developing a new custom automated network simulation analyzing and testing architecture full stack application, written in  C#/.NET and object oriented programming
●	Lead, design and develop a test automation relay switch controller application written in C#/.NET and object oriented programming
●	Created and maintaining our custom functional quality test post processor to help create government and program/project test reports, written in C#/.Net and object oriented programming
●	Continue to create government and different program/project quality tests and execute them the functional quality test post processing application for the results
●	Continue creating and leading a team to save the new network simulation analyzing and testing architecture test results into a SQL Management server
●	Create JIRA Agile sprints for tracking programs and projects
●	Create JIRA to create tickets for bugs and tasks

positions.title: Senior Specialist Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead, designed and developed a qualification functional tests within a custom Test Automated Framework
•	Lead, designed and developed a custom internal asset tracker RFID scanning system written in C#/.NET and object oriented programming
•	Lead, designed and developed a custom radio mode switch controller (Arduino), written in C#/.NET and object oriented programming to be able to automate Harris technologies; allowing users to work from home remotely and CI/CD systems to operate 24/7
•	Lead, designed and developed a self-rating and graded scorecards based on product's quality results
Project Coordinator for Falcon III products
•	Lead, designed and developed a custom test automation framework using Microsoft Visual Studio, XML, and written in C#/.Net, and object oriented programming
•	Mentored and lead engineers and developers to utilize and develop new methods
•	Built a user interface tool to empower users to take advantage of the framework to design automated test cases and run them without the need to view or modify code
•	Developed custom testing tools using Microsoft Visual Studio, XML, C#/.Net, object oriented programming and C++ to help reduce the team's workload
•	Resolved assigned JIRA trouble reports by the agreed upon date due
•	Used Tortoise SVN when creating, storing and/or managing shared software development source code

positions.title: Software Specialist Engineer
positions.locationName: Rochester, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:

•	Over-the-Air field testing on military RF radios technologies for embedded software and interoperability issues
•	Assisted engineers in analyzing test results, bugs, data logs and solving possible problems found during tests
•	Utilized and researched testing requirements on DOORS for all testing efforts
•	Imported, exported, compared, monitored and updated software project documents, code and results
•	Authored, modified and performed functional qualification test, Sierra terminal program and procedures
•	Used Tortoise SVN when creating, storing and/or managing shared software development source code
